memory.files.link: {{path}} is a link, so AgentChainer won't open it: it could point outside the workspace.
memory.files.tooLarge: It's over 2 MB, too large to open here.
memory.save.changed: {{path}} changed since you opened it. Reload it to see the new version; copy your edits first if you want to keep them.
memory.save.homePath: It mentions a path in a home folder, which only works on one computer.
memory.save.long: It has {{lines}} lines. Over {{max}}, it costs context in every session.
memory.save.secret: It holds what looks like a key or token. CLAUDE.md is committed and sent to Claude in every session: keep keys in your environment and refer to them by name.
memory.save.title: Edit {{path}}
memory.save.tooLarge: It's over {{kb}} KB. Claude reads all of it in every session: keep it short and link to longer docs instead.
memory.save.urlPassword: It has a URL with a password in it. Check it's only a local example before you commit.
